document_title: State Board of Secondary & Higher Secondary Education - Circular No. 44/2026: March 2027 Final Examination Enrollment
issuing_authority: State Board Examination Controller, Enrollment Wing

plain_language_summary.summary: All eligible regular and private candidates for the Class XII Final Examination 2027 must complete online enrollment, verify biometric data, and upload academic credentials before December 10, 2026.
plain_language_summary.evidence_quote: Online enrollment and submission of e-dossiers for March 2027 examinations shall close on 10-12-2026.

deadlines.description: Final date for candidates to complete online registration form and pay standard exam fees.
deadlines.evidence_quote: The last date for student enrollment without late fees is 10th December 2026.

deadlines.description: Extended late registration window with statutory late fine.
deadlines.evidence_quote: Portal will re-open from 11-12-2026 to 20-12-2026 with late registration fee.

required_documents.name: Class X Passing Certificate & Marksheet
required_documents.evidence_quote: Original scanned copy of Class 10 board marksheet must be uploaded.

required_documents.name: Passport Size Color Photograph (White Background, < 100 KB)
required_documents.evidence_quote: Recent passport photograph with white background in JPEG format not exceeding 100 KB.

required_documents.name: Disability / PwD Certificate from District Medical Board (if claiming scribe/extra time)
required_documents.evidence_quote: Candidates requiring compensatory time must attach valid medical certificate issued by competent authority.

submission_channel.channel: Official Board Online Examination Portal: https://boardexam.state.edu/reg2027
submission_channel.evidence_quote: Candidate applications must be registered exclusively through https://boardexam.state.edu/reg2027

penalties.description: Late fee of Rs. 250 for registration during extended window
penalties.evidence_quote: A late fine of Rs. 250 shall be levied per candidate registering after 10-12-2026.

action_steps.action: Enter unique Student ID to populate academic records and verify personal details.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 1: Enter unique Student ID to populate academic records and verify personal details.

action_steps.action: Upload digital copies of mandatory documents as per portal specifications.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 2: Upload digital copies of mandatory documents as per portal specifications.

action_steps.action: Remit fee through payment gateway and generate barcoded acknowledgment receipt.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 3: Remit fee through payment gateway and generate barcoded acknowledgment receipt.
